notes.title: Prison Notes: Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160561/1f57ec2569e5d0275e0964317da69723dee9d0b0.png[/img]

Dear supporters and fans of Prison Notes,

Over the past year, we’ve poured our hearts into creating a game that we truly love and find genuinely fun. We’re confident that this game is unique and distinctive, and we can’t wait to share its exciting experience with even more players.

We want to sincerely thank everyone who participated in the Prison Notes demo. Your feedback and suggestions have been incredibly valuable to us! After continuous improvements and refinements, we’re thrilled to announce that the game is expected to officially launch in Q1 2025.

[b][i]Pricing Details:[/i][/b]
The price for Prison Notes is set at [b]¥37 RMB[/b], with an exclusive [b]20% discount[/b] during the launch period!

Thank you so much for your support and enthusiasm for our very first game. We can’t wait to bring you the final version of this experience!

notes.title: The demo for Prison Notes is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160561/0d33a5d5c484be1db6c112159a2e36c497dabe4a.png[/img]

Dear Players,

Thank you for your interest in The Chronicles of the Iron Bars! Please note that as the game is still under development, you may encounter certain events with shorter sequences or simpler text, and some in-game mechanics are still being refined. We appreciate your understanding.

You are welcome to join our official QQ group: 580628484, or use the in-game links to report bugs and provide suggestions. You can also connect with other players and share your experiences.

We hope you enjoy the game!

Best regards,
Vinland Studio
